summary: Customer-delivery handoff plan derived from the current delivery-readiness analysis. The repository is already technically deliverable, so this CSV plan focuses on freezing one auditable baseline, defining a clean customer package boundary, manually smoke-checking the real writer UI golden path, assembling the customer-facing handoff bundle, and making one final GO/GO-with-notes/HOLD decision.
approach: Use a three-wave CSV execution plan that first locks the validated baseline and clean package boundary, then performs one real UI golden-path smoke plus handoff bundle preparation, and finally runs one final verification and delivery decision sweep.
estimated_time: 3 focused waves with one final decision sweep
recommended_execution: Wave-based CSV pipeline with low-conflict parallelism

current_state.delivery_readiness: GO-backed and currently green on desktop/backend local gates
current_state.ui_api_workflow_alignment: main writer workflow is aligned across desktop UI, workspace contract, and backend workflow endpoints
current_state.customer_handoff_gap: formal handoff baseline, package boundary definition, and real UI smoke confirmation should be made explicit before external delivery

constraints: Do not reopen broad feature or architecture work
Preserve the current authoritative desktop + gateway delivery contract
Prefer one authoritative handoff bundle over duplicate summaries
Keep wave scopes non-overlapping and decision oriented
deferred_out_of_scope: Broad documentation modernization beyond customer handoff artifacts
Re-designing the UI instead of smoke-validating the current product
